theorems.statement: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K (FractionRing (Polynomial K))), algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) Polynomial.X ∈ v.toValuationSubring → ∃ q : Polynomial K, q.Monic ∧ Irreducible q ∧ (∀ f : FractionRing (Polynomial K), f ∈ v.toValuationSubring ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) a / algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) b)
theorems.natural_summary: Constants and X generate the polynomial ring inside the valuation subring. Its contracted maximal ideal is a nonzero prime ideal, whose normalized generator q is monic and irreducible. The frozen-base localization theorem identifies membership with polynomial fractions whose denominators lie outside (q), equivalently denominators not divisible by q.
